latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release.  
- Instantly generates synced karaoke lyric videos from audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC up to 200MB).
- Upload your song and lyrics, get a 1080p MP4 with word/bounce lyric highlights in ~1–2 minutes.
- No installation needed — all processing is cloud-based.
- Free session tokens with 100 credits (valid 7 days); simple setup with auto-reconnection if expired.
- Supports file upload, timeline previews, credits checking, and easy export/download.
- Guides users through common workflows including quick edits, batch jobs, and iterative refinements.
